exposure: International Association of the Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Group (IADPSG) criteria for gestational diabetes
Carpenter and Coustan (C&C) criteria for gestational diabetes
cohort: 1,840 women who delivered singletons in 2011 in a single tertiary center.
finding: Adopting the IADPSG criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus is associated with improved pregnancy outcomes compared to the C&C criteria, despite increased prevalence of diagnosis.
mod_finding: Adopting the IADPSG criteria was associated with a reduced risk of primary cesarean section.
